text.tspan: FCA has recently received multiple reports of anomalous events with a high degree of
consistency.All affected individuals exhibit the same anomalous state:
significantly reduced responsiveness to external stimuli,
gradual cessation of voluntary behavior, while continuously maintaining an unnatural state
of wakefulness and being unable to voluntarily fall asleep.
Following initial systematic screening, no known diseases or conventional drugs have been
found that can fully explain this phenomenon. The investigation department speculates that
the affected individuals may have come into contact with an unknown psychoactive agent,
which appears to be capable of continuously interfering with human perception, attention,
N-01 may exist in a non-traditional way,
